comment: Route 2 of docs/SQLITE.md: a user-defined tool around the sqlite3 shell. The SQL is read from the JSON on stdin, because a JICHI_ARG_ variable is cut at 1023 bytes without a word. -safe is NOT optional: without it the shell runs .shell commands and readfile()/writefile() even on a read-only database, and readonly:true means no approval prompt.

tools.name: sql_query
tools.description: Run ONE read-only SQLite query against learning.db and return the rows as JSON. Tables: lessons(id, title, minutes), progress(lesson_id, done_on, score). Writes are refused.
